# 0016. One source of truth; generated files are never edited or committed

## Context

Catalogue tables, coverage lists and project notes were copied by hand and drifted.

## Decision

Every fact lives in exactly one source file. Catalogue tables, coverage, previews, documentation pages and built packages are generated by the CLI in CI and published (releases, website), not committed. A CI check fails if anything generated is edited by hand. Notes outside the repositories (chat projects, docs) only link to the repositories.

## Consequences

Pull requests only contain sources, so they stay reviewable.
